what_it_limits: All structures are antigen-bound crystal complexes; unbound conformational states not observed
what_it_does_not_invalidate: Within-bound-state comparisons (VHH vs VH) remain valid, since both cohorts share this bias equally
recommended_final_wording: Observations describe bound-state paratope and surface geometry, not unbound conformational accessibility.

what_it_limits: CDR3 conformation, framework exposure, and interface geometry may be influenced by crystal contacts
what_it_does_not_invalidate: Large-N, cohort-level statistical comparisons across 533-1429 independent crystal structures average out most idiosyncratic packing effects
recommended_final_wording: Individual structure geometry may be influenced by crystal packing; population-level comparisons are less sensitive to this than any single structure.

what_it_limits: No wet-lab solubility assay was performed or referenced
what_it_does_not_invalidate: Structural/sequence differences at the former interface remain validly observed independent of any solubility claim
recommended_final_wording: This project does not directly demonstrate higher experimental solubility for VHH.

what_it_limits: No calorimetry, melting-temperature, or folding free-energy data
what_it_does_not_invalidate: Structural accommodation findings (shielding, patch phenotype) remain valid as structural descriptors
recommended_final_wording: This project does not directly demonstrate higher thermodynamic stability for VHH.

what_it_limits: No KD, kon/koff, or SPR/ITC data; antigen-contact participation is not affinity
what_it_does_not_invalidate: Contact-participation and paratope-organization findings remain valid as structural descriptors of the observed complex
recommended_final_wording: Antigen-contact participation describes structural engagement, not binding affinity or biological potency.

what_it_limits: No AggreScan3D or comparable computational developability prediction was run
what_it_does_not_invalidate: PSH/patch/electrostatic descriptors remain valid empirical spatial descriptors in their own right
recommended_final_wording: Surface patch and electrostatic descriptors are empirical structural quantities, not validated aggregation predictors in this project.

what_it_limits: CDR3 elevation/horizontal-orientation angles (Gordon 2023) could not be computed; excluded from all models
what_it_does_not_invalidate: rho, compactness, and FR2_CDR3_Dis remain fully resolved and used throughout
recommended_final_wording: Gordon theta/phi remain an unresolved method dependency (Text S2 unavailable) and were not used anywhere in this project.

what_it_limits: Cohorts are SAbDab2-derived, Gordon-contact-gated, nonredundant representatives -- not a random sample of all possible VHH/VH sequences
what_it_does_not_invalidate: Within this defined, transparently-documented cohort, comparisons remain internally valid
recommended_final_wording: Findings describe the structurally characterized, antigen-engaged SAbDab2-derived cohort, not the full universe of VHH/VH sequences.

what_it_limits: Antigens vary widely in size, chemistry, and class
what_it_does_not_invalidate: Composition audit (Stage 9) and dominant-antigen exclusion sensitivity (Stage 11) confirm no single antigen drives the central conclusions
recommended_final_wording: Central conclusions were confirmed stable after excluding the single most-represented antigen identity (Spike protein S1, N=37).

what_it_limits: Shielding and BSA cannot be statistically separated (VIF=15.5); CDR3 length is intertwined with shielding, engagement, and framework/CDR3 fraction
what_it_does_not_invalidate: The existence of a coupled CDR3-geometric-accommodation module remains well supported; only the decomposition into independent sub-mechanisms is limited
recommended_final_wording: Shielding, packing, and CDR3 length are represented as one coupled geometric-accommodation module rather than independently separable mechanisms.

what_it_limits: All Stage-11 associations are cross-sectional regression results, not causal or mediation analyses
what_it_does_not_invalidate: Associations remain valid descriptions of the fitted statistical relationships within the observed data
recommended_final_wording: All reported relationships are statistical associations; no causal or mediation claim is made anywhere in this project.

what_it_limits: Electrostatic potential was sampled at exposed atom coordinates, not a solvent-excluded molecular-surface mesh; values can be dominated by the local charged-atom environment
what_it_does_not_invalidate: Relative VHH-vs-VH comparisons at matched sampling points remain valid; only absolute magnitude interpretation is limited
recommended_final_wording: APBS potential was sampled at exposed former-interface atom coordinates, explicitly not a solvent-excluded molecular-surface integral.
